$comment: R-062 cross-tier verdict fixture. HAND-AUTHORED, not emitted by generate-inputs.ts: only the Go compiler stamps `unsoundPrimitives`, and only for verifySP1FRI behind an explicit compile-time acknowledgement, so there is no .runar.ts in this repo the generator could compile into this shape. The SDK gate reads ONLY the artifact's `unsoundPrimitives` field, so the script body is deliberately the ordinary P2PKH template every tier already agrees on — what is under test is the funding VERDICT on the wallet path, not the codegen. Sibling fixtures r062-wallet-ordinary and r062-wallet-unsound-acknowledged are the two controls that keep this gate from becoming an outage for every legitimate wallet deploy.

expectRefusal.pattern: does not claim is sound: verifySP1FRI
expectRefusal.reason: R-062. The artifact declares unsoundPrimitives, and the caller funding it through the tier's WALLET path acknowledged nothing. deploy() has refused this since R-062 landed; the wallet path is a SECOND funding path that skipped the gate in five of the seven SDKs (TS, Ruby, Python, Go, Rust), so a Go-compiled SP1-FRI artifact was funded in silence. All seven must now refuse, and name the primitive.
